jobs.prompt:
Write failing tests before writing any fix. You must produce: - A mechanical (vanilla BDD) test using /bdd.development if this is a code failure. - An agentic BDD test using /agent-bdd.development if there is an AI/agent failure

Do not skip the agentic test when it applies ? err on the side of including it.
The failing test is a hard requirement ? write it first, run it, confirm it fails. You may alter existing tests or add new ones, but an explicit red test capturing the defect must exist before any fix is written.
jobs.judge_criteria: PASS only when: (1) at least one failing test exists that captures the defect; (2) a mechanical BDD test is present for code failures; (3) an agentic BDD test is present when an AI/agent failure is involved; (4) tests were validated against the tools as normal.

jobs.prompt:

Before writing any code: - Explore all impacted codebases and the code they depend on. - Read module-context.md for every module you touch. - Study the existing idioms, patterns, and usage in detail. Do not invent new patterns or paradigms ? follow what is already there. A defect fix should not require new patterns.
jobs.judge_criteria: PASS only when: (1) all BDD tests pass; (2) all agentic BDD tests pass; (3) the fix follows existing patterns, paradigms, and usage ? no new patterns invented without strong justification; (4) validated against the tools as normal.
